The perp notional in USD was calculated based on the position size and the price of ETH-PERP on Binance. Daily funding revenue was calculated using the funding rate and the perp notional. Entry costs include the maker fees for both spot and perp trades, as well as the network transfer fee. Break-even periods were calculated by dividing the entry costs by the daily funding revenue.
